rule.dev505: A development dish is a dish_id in results/p0d/same_budget_dishes.jsonl with method=='ours_new' and paired==true. That set equals the paired ids of direct_vlm, ours_old, and open_loop_bc, and equals results/coverage_early_stop/paired_scores.jsonl.
rule.fit: Fit is an official rgb_train dish_id with pool_of_dish=='fit': int(sha256(dish_id).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 10 != 0. This is vdr.weak.teacher.pool_of_dish. The same ids are the dish set of results/weak_steps/rgb_train_fit_all.jsonl. Mass training used the overhead-RGB subset of this set. Q and tau used the weak steps of this set. The rgb_train internal hold-out (% 10 == 0) is not fit and is also excluded from this external list.
rule.heldout: Held-out is every dish_id in data/nutrition5k/metadata/dish_metadata_cafe2.csv whose overhead rgb.png exists. The list is sorted by dish_id. Cafe2 is the source. The first CSV field is the only field read. No nutrition number, error, or component count is a filter. Ids are kept whole; decision steps are not split. Missing images are listed and are not a label drop.
rule.not_used: Held-out membership is fixed before evaluation. It is not a method choice, an early stop, a tau choice, or a food-code or portion edit.

score_labels.development_505_label: unchanged cafe1 dish-level load_labels; not recomputed here
score_labels.energy: sum of ingredient energy_kcal on the same cafe2 row. The dish-level energy column is 0 on every cafe2 row, so that column is not used.
score_labels.mass: dish-level mass_g. It equals the sum of ingredient grams on every cafe2 row.

source_isolation: Held-out is cafe2 only. The paired 505 and rgb_train are cafe1
